label.purpose: Field captions, filter captions, and table headers at 0.8rem / 500 / mute.

shadows.name: thumb-loft

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Run: near-black pill with a 1.5px chartreuse ring.
components.css: .ds-run { padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--s0); background: var(--s6); border: 1.5px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-run:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #000; } .ds-run:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0.5px); } .ds-run:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-run:disabled { color: var(--s0); background: var(--s5); border-color: var(--s5); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Cancel, CSV, and Close: paper pill, hairline, full-opacity disabled.
components.css: .ds-ghost { padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--s6); background: var(--paper); border: var(--hair); border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--s1); } .ds-ghost:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0.5px); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--s6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ghost:disabled { opacity: 1; color: var(--s5); border-color: var(--s3); background: var(--paper); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: URL Textarea
components.description: Intake field: paper, hairline, 14px radius, five-line minimum.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field > span { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--s5); } .ds-field textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 124px; padding: 8px; color: var(--s6); background: var(--paper); border: var(--hair); border-radius: 14px; resize: vertical; font: inherit; } .ds-field textarea::placeholder { color: var(--s5); } .ds-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--s6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pill Input
components.description: Search and filter fields: paper pill with hairline.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-input > span { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--s5); } .ds-input input { width: 100%; padding: 8px; color: var(--s6); background: var(--paper); border: var(--hair); border-radius: 999px; font: inherit; } .ds-input input::placeholder { color: var(--s5); } .ds-input input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--s6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Classification Tag
components.description: Mist pill for hook, tactics, and classified choice cells.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; margin: 0 4px 4px 0; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--s1); border: var(--hair); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--s6); }

components.name: Empty Proof
components.description: Vacant table slot: paper radial, hairline, 16px radius.
components.html: Paste Ad Library URLs to start.
components.css: .ds-empty { margin: 24px 0; padding: 16px 18px; max-width: 62ch; color: var(--s6); background: radial-gradient(80% 120% at 50% 0%, #ffffff 0%, var(--s0) 70%); border: var(--hair); border-radius: 16px; }

components.name: URL Slot
components.description: One of five URL berths. Success is a 7px accent dot; fail is an ink border.
components.css: .ds-slots { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; } .ds-slots li { position: relative; padding: 8px; background: var(--paper); border: var(--hair); border-radius: 12px; } .ds-slots li.ok::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 9px; right: 9px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); } .ds-slots li.fail { border-color: var(--s6); }

components.name: Results Table
components.description: Proof wrap plus classified row. Same paper language as the empty state.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow: auto; background: radial-gradient(80% 120% at 50% 0%, #ffffff 0%, var(--s0) 70%); border: var(--hair); border-radius: 16px; } .ds-results { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-results th, .ds-results td { text-align: left; vertical-align: top; padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--s2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-results th { padding: 0; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--s5); background: rgb(250 250 250 / 0.92); } .ds-results th button { appearance: none; width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-results th button:hover { background: var(--s1); } .ds-results th button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--s6); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-results tbody tr { cursor: pointer; } .ds-results tbody tr:hover { background: var(--s1); } .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--s1); border: var(--hair); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview:
adjudge wears Monochrome Product Marketing as a tool, not as a campaign. The seven-step near-white to near-black scale, Satoshi, hairline chrome, ghost pills, and a single chartreuse mark are the catalog world's materials; the page itself stays an analyst workbench. Title, intake, slots, filters, and the proof (empty or table) remain where they already sit. Nothing is restaged into a hero, a sidebar shell, or a marketing narrative.

The atmosphere is paper: a gallery ground, a fixed micro-noise film, and quiet radial highlights. Depth is tonal. Controls are white pills with a hairline until Run, which is near-black with the only chromatic stroke. Proofs — the empty state and the results table — share one paper language so a successful scrape does not change the furniture.

This system is the operate expression of `digital-design-canon-monochrome-product-marketing`. It keeps the world's scale, type, chrome, and ring, and leaves the catalog card's poster composition (oversized display type, device mock, campaign headline) on the reference sheet.
keyCharacteristics: Seven-step neutral scale (`--s0`–`--s6`) plus bright paper and one chartreuse
Self-hosted Satoshi at 400 / 500 / 700 on a Helvetica Neue fallback stack
Hairline chrome (`1px solid --s2`); pills for controls; 16px radii for proofs
Primary action is ink-filled with a 1.5px accent ring
Product thumbs sit on radial grounds; proofs use the same paper + hairline + radial recipe
Intersection-driven soft rise on `[data-proof]`; reduced motion turns it off

rules.name: The Chartreuse-as-Proof Rule
rules.body: Accent marks the thing that runs and the slot that succeeded. If a new control needs color, it does not get a second hue — it gets ink, hairline, or this same chartreuse in a 7px dot or a 1.5px ring.

rules.name: The Seven-Step Rule
rules.body: Neutrals come from `--s0`–`--s6` plus `--paper`. Do not insert a warm or cool tint between steps. Run's hover fill `#000000` is a one-off darker than ink; it is not a new scale step.

rules.name: The Satoshi Three-Weight Rule
rules.body: Regular for body, medium for controls and labels, bold for the two titles. No italics, no fourth weight, no second UI family. Mono is a drawer inspection face, not a brand face.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Chrome is a 1px `--s2` stroke. Do not add ambient card shadows, hover lifts, or a third shadow role. Thumbs and the drawer already have the only loft the world uses.

dos: Do keep proofs (empty and table) on the same paper + hairline + 16px + top-lit radial recipe, in the same slot.
Do paint Run as ink-on-gallery with a 1.5px chartreuse ring; paint every other action as a paper ghost pill.
Do signal URL success with a 7px accent dot and URL failure with an ink border — not a second chroma.
Do sit product thumbs on radial grounds; keep a broken thumb as a placeholder so the row never disappears.
Do use Satoshi 400 / 500 / 700 and the seven-step scale as declared on `:root`.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion` by skipping the proof rise.
donts: Don't introduce a second chromatic color, an accent fill, or an accent page wash.
Don't restage the operate workbench as a landing-page hero, device mock, or default SaaS shell.
Don't add ambient card shadows or hover lift to chrome; loft stays on thumbs and the drawer.
Don't fade disabled controls — recolor them (mute type, silver or mute border).
Don't invent a painted role for Pewter (`s4`) just because the step exists; leave the ladder intact.
